game.name: Ember Drift
game.description: A two-minute hand-painted space dodge. Weave through the emberfall, gather fallen stars, and keep the little skiff alight.

author.buildInstructions: No npm install and no third-party dependencies. From source commit f51033ce7f3a2fcb5aa60738f493c7509a48d853: npm run build && npm run validate && npm run pack. Node >= 20. If the local platform checkout moved, set DSH_GAME_CLI=/path/to/dsh-game-market/scripts/cli/dsh-game.mjs before the npm scripts. The local dsh-game.config.json records the evaluator checkout path and must be regenerated or overridden for public reproducibility.

licensing.notes: No third-party art, audio, fonts or other assets are included. The package uses system font families and canvas-drawn visuals only. The MIT text is in the project LICENSE file.
